capabilities: Capture startup and per-plugin load times automatically on boot
Write startup-metrics.json, startup-metrics.md, and startup-history.jsonl logs
Run an isolation benchmark of all active plugins
Copy a pre-formatted AI diagnostic summary to the clipboard
Keep the plugin first in community-plugins.json load order
extras: Recommends enabling Obsidian's built-in "Debug startup time" setting for exact cold-start numbers; the plugin automatically rewrites community-plugins.json to load before all other plugins.
intentEvidence: Obsidian already has a built-in "Debug startup time" option
motivation: The author wanted persistent, structured startup measurements that AI assistants and external scripts can inspect, since the built-in debug option provides none of that.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Debug startup time option only shows a transient popup and does not persist data to disk or provide historical logs that scripts and AI assistants can analyze.
summary: Diagnostics plugin that measures Obsidian startup time and per-plugin load times, writing JSON, Markdown, and JSONL logs for AI analysis.
